_comment: Guided tour for the File Tools hub. The window is a navigation list plus a lazy panel area, so the tour is about choosing the right panel for the operation you actually mean.

steps.title: One hub, one kind of work
steps.text:
Everything in this window acts on a file: it moves a measurement between containers, reads one back, or corrects a header. No panel here measures anything — the analyses live elsewhere on purpose.

Pick a tool on the left; its panel opens on the right.

steps.title: The converters move, they do not change
steps.text: TTTR Split / Convert, TTTR → Time Windows and ⇄ .pto all rewrite a recording into a different container. Conversion never touches the photons — if a count comes out different afterwards, the header was wrong, not the conversion.

await.hint: Select a converter panel from the list.

steps.title: Inspect before you trust
steps.text: PTO Inspector reads what a .pto actually contains, and the TTTR header editor shows the tags a vendor wrote — the ones every later step takes on faith. Wrong micro-time card, wrong resolution, wrong detector number: this is where those are caught.

steps.title: One broken tool breaks one panel
steps.text: Panels load lazily and independently, so a sub-tool whose dependencies are missing shows an error panel and the rest of the hub still works. If a panel fails to open, the problem is that tool's — not the file you dropped on another one.
